lead_en: Request to people living near the river: move from the riverside to higher ground and stay on high alert.
lead_ne: नदी नजिक बस्नेहरूलाई अनुरोध: नदी किनारबाट अग्लो स्थानमा सर्नुहोस् र उच्च सतर्क रहनुहोस्।
body_en: The flood entered the Bhotekoshi in Rasuwa from the Tibet side and joined the Trishuli via the Lende Khola. After Galchhi and Gajuri, Armed Police reported it passing Adamghat in Dhading and continuing downstream toward Devghat.
body_ne: बाढी रसुवामा तिब्बततर्फबाट भोटेकोशीमा प्रवेश गरी लेन्डे खोला हुँदै त्रिशूलीमा मिसिएको हो। गल्छी र गजुरीपछि सशस्त्र प्रहरीका अनुसार धादिङको आदमघाट हुँदै देवघाटतर्फ बग्दै गएको छ।

points.notes_en: Border checkpoint area; bridges and infrastructure destroyed.
points.notes_ne: सीमा नाका क्षेत्र; पुल र संरचना नष्ट।

points.notes_en: Downstream of the entry point on the Bhotekoshi.
DHM gauge: day's peak 6.57 m at 16:00, flow about 5,850 m³/s.
points.notes_ne: जलविज्ञान मापन केन्द्र: दिनको उच्च बिन्दु ६.५७ मि. १६:०० बजे, बहाव करिब ५,८५० घनमिटर/सेकेन्ड।

points.notes_en: The Narayani carried the flood past Bharatpur. Chitwan has the highest recorded district death toll.
points.notes_ne: नारायणीले बाढी भरतपुरसम्म पुर्‍यायो। जिल्लागत रूपमा सबैभन्दा बढी मृत्यु चितवनमा दर्ता भएको छ।

points.notes_en: Nawalparasi East recorded the second-highest district death toll.
points.notes_ne: जिल्लागत रूपमा दोस्रो धेरै मृत्यु नवलपरासी पूर्वमा दर्ता भएको छ।

points.notes_en: Projected downstream reach toward the border. Shown as an estimate, not a confirmed observation.
points.notes_ne: सीमातर्फको अनुमानित तल्लो प्रवाह। यो अनुमान हो, पुष्टि भएको अवलोकन होइन।

sources.label: DHM Flood Forecasting Division situation report (10 Bhadra 2083)

_comment_status: Point `status` drives how the map draws it. 'entry' = where the flood crossed into Nepal. 'confirmed' = the water is confirmed to have reached here. 'estimated' = downstream reach that is projected or at risk, drawn dashed and labelled as an estimate — never as an observation. Downstream 'confirmed' points below Devghat are justified by the Nepal Police district death toll in sitrep.json (Chitwan 264, Nawalparasi East 194, Nawalparasi West 120 as of 14 Bhadra 15:00), which cannot be true unless the water arrived. Do not promote a point to 'confirmed' without that kind of basis.
